info.title: Shillinq Register
info.description: Register containing all schemas for the Shillinq application.

x-openregister.description: Shillinq — open-source business administration suite for Dutch SMB, ZZP, and government.

example.title: Example
example.description: Example schema — replace with your app's actual schemas.

title.description: The title of the example object

GLLine.title: GL Line
GLLine.description: A debit-or-credit line within a GLTransaction, encoding the polarity in the side enum per REQ-GL-003. Extended with eliminationFlag to support GR consolidation per REQ-GRC-003.

side.description: Debit or credit polarity; amount is always non-negative.

amount.description: Non-negative posting amount in the transaction's currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Must equal the parent GLTransaction.currency (T1 single-currency invariant).

periodId.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod. Auto-resolved by the lifecycle engine on the GLTransaction.post transition.

subLedgerType.description: Sub-ledger discriminator; T2 owns the actual sub-ledger registers.

subLedgerRef.description: FK into the sub-ledger when subLedgerType is not none.

costCenter.description: Cost-center or department code for allocation reporting.

eliminationFlag.description: When true, excludes this line from the consolidated trial-balance and financial-statement aggregations. Used to eliminate inter-GR transactions from consolidated views per REQ-GRC-003.

taakveld.description: FK to Taakveld.code classifying this line into a BBV function. Defaults from Account.taakveld; overridable within the allowed set per REQ-BBV-002. Reserve mutations must carry taakveld 0.10 per REQ-BBV-004.

economischeCategorie.description: FK to EconomischeCategorie.code (Iv3 cost-type) for this line. Defaults from Account.economischeCategorie per REQ-BBV-002.

rechtmatigheidStatus.description: Rechtmatigheids-classification of this posting per REQ-BBV-009. Set by year-close aggregation against the raad-configured rapportagegrens/goedkeuringstolerantie.

consolidatedTrialBalance.description: Trial-balance rollup that excludes inter-GR lines flagged for elimination. Produces debit and credit totals per accountNumber for the GR own jaarrekening per REQ-GRC-003.

GRDeelnemer.title: GR Deelnemer
GRDeelnemer.description: A deelnemer (participating municipality, province, or waterboard) of a gemeenschappelijke regeling (GR). Holds the quotum-aandeel and an optional cross-administration FK for doorbelasting materialisation per REQ-GRC-001.

administrationId.description: Optional FK to the deelnemer's own shillinq administration. When set, a balanced GLTransaction is materialised in that administration on GR period-close per REQ-GRC-005.

aandeel.description: Quotum-aandeel (participation share) of this deelnemer in the GR. Must be 0 ≤ x ≤ 1. The sum across all actief deelnemers SHOULD equal 1.0.

actief.description: Whether this deelnemer currently participates in the GR. Inactive deelnemers are excluded from the aandeel-sum invariant check.

lifecycleState.description: Lifecycle state of the deelnemer record.

active.label: Active
active.description: Deelnemer participates in the GR and is included in aandeel-sum and doorbelasting calculations.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Deelnemer no longer participates. Historical records remain queryable; excluded from aandeel-sum and doorbelasting calculations.

archive.label: Archive deelnemer
archive.description: Remove from active participation without deleting historical boekingen.

onGrPeriodClose.description: When the GR period closes, materialise a balanced GLTransaction in each deelnemer's administration where administrationId is set. Idempotency key: (grAdministrationId, deelnemerId, periodId) prevents re-posting on re-run of GR period-close per REQ-GRC-005.
onGrPeriodClose.condition: administrationId IS NOT NULL AND lifecycleState = 'active'

aandeelSumCheck.description: Computes the sum of aandeel across all actief deelnemers. Surfaces a non-blocking warning in the Consolidated view when the result differs from 1.0 per REQ-GRC-004 and design Risk 2.

GRVerdeelsleutel.title: GR Verdeelsleutel
GRVerdeelsleutel.description: An apportionment rule linking a cost-cluster (set of accountNumbers) to a per-deelnemer split method. Multiple verdeelsleutels MAY apply to the same cost cluster, sequenced by lineNumber per REQ-GRC-002.

sleutelNaam.description: Human-readable name of this apportionment rule.

costClusterAccountNumbers.description: Array of Account.accountNumber strings identifying the cost cluster this verdeelsleutel applies to.

verdelingsType.description: Apportionment method. vast-percentage uses fixed per-deelnemer percentages in parameters; inwoner-aantal weights by population count; gewogen-oppervlak by weighted surface area; custom-formula accepts free-form parameters JSON.

parameters.description: Per-deelnemer split parameters validated against verdelingsType. For vast-percentage: object keyed by GRDeelnemer.id with values summing to 1.0. For custom-formula: arbitrary JSON.

lineNumber.description: Sequence number controlling the order in which multiple verdeelsleutels for the same cost cluster are applied.

doorbelastingPerDeelnemer.description: Per-deelnemer doorbelasting aggregation: applies this verdeelsleutel to GLLines whose accountNumber is in costClusterAccountNumbers (excluding eliminated lines). Produces doorbelasting bedrag per deelnemer per cost cluster per REQ-GRC-004.

join.condition: GLLine.accountNumber IN costClusterAccountNumbers AND GLLine.eliminationFlag = false

Account.title: Account
Account.description: A hierarchical chart-of-accounts entry conforming to the RGS (Referentie Grootboek Schema) standard for Dutch bookkeeping.

accountNumber.description: RGS-style account code (e.g. '1000', '4100'). Unique within an administration.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this account's base currency.

parentAccountNumber.description: FK to the parent Account.accountNumber for hierarchy navigation.

isClosingAccount.description: Designates this as the administration's single closing account for period-end equity absorption.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this account. Scopes uniqueness of accountNumber.

lifecycleState.description: Current lifecycle state of the account.

description.description: Operator-authored free-text description of the account.

vatApplicable.description: Whether VAT/BTW applies to transactions posted to this account.

rgsDecentraalCode.description: FK to BbvAccountMapping.rgsDecentraalCode — the RGS-decentraal D-code establishing the wettelijke positie of this account. Required for BBV-tenants (administrationType ∈ {gemeente, provincie, waterschap}) per REQ-BBV-001.

taakveld.description: FK to Taakveld.code — default function-classification for exploitatie accounts. Required for exploitatie accounts in BBV-tenants per REQ-BBV-002; overridable per GL line within the allowed set for the taakveld.

economischeCategorie.description: FK to EconomischeCategorie.code — default Iv3 cost-type for this account. Required for BBV-tenants per REQ-BBV-002.

bbvClassificatie.description: BBV routing discriminator determining posting constraints (reserve→taakveld 0.10, voorziening→gekoppelde taakveld) per REQ-BBV-004. Required for BBV-tenants.

active.label: Active
active.description: Fully usable for new GL postings.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Readable and referenceable by existing postings, but rejected as the target of new GL lines.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Historical only — no new postings, no edits; remains queryable.

block.label: Block account
block.description: Prevent new postings against this account.

unblock.label: Unblock account
unblock.description: Re-enable new postings against this account.

archiveFromActive.label: Archive account
archiveFromActive.description: Move to historical archive. Requires zero open balance.

archiveFromBlocked.label: Archive account
archiveFromBlocked.description: Move to historical archive from blocked state. Requires zero open balance.

Iv3Export.title: IV3 Export
Iv3Export.description: Quarterly IV3 (Informatie voor Derden) export to CBS for Dutch decentralised government administrations. Lifecycle covers generation, validation, submission, and CBS acceptance/rejection.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration (gemeente/provincie/waterschap) that this export belongs to.

reportingYear.description: Calendar year of the IV3 reporting period (e.g. 2026).

iv3Version.description: CBS IV3-bestand specification version used for this export (e.g. '2026.1').

buckets.description: Aggregated GL values keyed by IV3 bucket code (sum of debit minus credit per bucket for closed-period postings). Derived via x-openregister-aggregations — do not set directly.

xmlAttachmentUri.description: Docudesk URI of the generated CBS IV3 XML file.

state.description: Current lifecycle state of the IV3 export.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the export was generated.

submittedAt.description: Timestamp when the export was submitted to CBS.

acceptedAt.description: Timestamp when CBS accepted the export.

cbsMessageId.description: CBS-side message identifier returned on submission.

correctionOf.description: FK to a prior Iv3Export.id that this export supersedes (correction flow).

generated.label: Generated
generated.description: Export created and XML artifact generated. Awaiting operator validation.

validated.label: Validated
validated.description: XML validated against the CBS IV3 schema. Ready for operator submission.

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.description: Submitted to CBS via OpenConnector cbs-iv3. Awaiting CBS acknowledgement.

accepted.label: Accepted
accepted.description: CBS accepted the export. Terminal state unless a correction is filed.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.description: CBS rejected the export. Operator must correct and re-validate.

corrected.label: Corrected
corrected.description: A correction export (with correctionOf set) supersedes this one.

retention.description: IV3 verantwoording-naar-derden records retained 10 years per Archiefwet 1995 + Selectielijst Gemeenten 2020.

validate.label: Validate XML
validate.description: Operator validates the generated XML against the CBS IV3 schema.

submit.label: Submit to CBS
submit.description: Operator submits the validated export to CBS via OpenConnector cbs-iv3.

accept.label: CBS Accepted
accept.description: CBS accepted the export (triggered by OpenConnector cbs-iv3 callback).

reject.label: CBS Rejected
reject.description: CBS rejected the export (triggered by OpenConnector cbs-iv3 callback).

revalidate.label: Re-validate after fix
revalidate.description: Operator re-validates after correcting the rejection reason.

correct.label: File correction
correct.description: Operator files a corrected export (sets correctionOf on the new Iv3Export).

buckets.description: Sum of (debit - credit) per IV3 bucket code over closed-period GLLine rows for this export's administrationId + quarter. Joins GLLine → Account → BbvAccountMapping.iv3Bucket (T3 bbv-compliance). Filters to periodIds closed per T2 period-close boundaries.

quarterly-cbs-submission.name: IV3 quarterly CBS submission
quarterly-cbs-submission.description: Generates and submits IV3 exports for all closed gemeente/provincie/waterschap administrations on a quarterly schedule.

Taakveld.title: Taakveld
Taakveld.description: A BBV taakveld (function code) per Iv3-informatievoorschrift. 53 for gemeente, 14 for provincie, ~12 for waterschap. The unit of BBV function-classification on every exploitatie posting per REQ-BBV-002.

code.description: Taakveld code (e.g. '0.10', '7.5'). Unique within an overheidslaag + geldigheid window.

hoofdfunctie.description: BBV hoofdfunctie (0-8) this taakveld rolls up to. Validated against code prefix at Iv3-export time per REQ-BBV-006.

omschrijvingIv3.description: Official Iv3-informatievoorschrift description of the taakveld scope.

overheidslaag.description: Which overheidslaag this taakveld catalogue applies to.

verplichteEconomischeCategorieen.description: Array of EconomischeCategorie.code values allowed/required for this taakveld. Empty array means all categorieën are allowed.

geldigVanaf.description: First date this taakveld version is effective (Iv3 catalogue versioning per design Risk 1).

geldigTot.description: Last date this taakveld version is effective; null = open-ended.

EconomischeCategorie.title: Economische Categorie
EconomischeCategorie.description: An Iv3 economische categorie (cost-type) — ~150 codes across 8 maingroups per Iv3-informatievoorschrift bijlage A. Drives the Iv3-aanlevering aggregation per REQ-BBV-006.

code.description: Economische categorie code (e.g. '3.4.3', '1.2.1'). Unique within a catalogue version.

naam.description: Human-readable name of the economische categorie.

niveau.description: Hierarchy level of the code (1 = maingroup, 3 = leaf).

parentCode.description: FK to the parent EconomischeCategorie.code for hierarchy navigation.

batenOfLasten.description: Whether postings on this categorie are baten, lasten, or balans-mutaties.

iv3Verplicht.description: Whether this categorie is mandatory in the Iv3-aanlevering per informatievoorschrift.

BbvAccountMapping.title: BBV Account Mapping
BbvAccountMapping.description: The RGS-decentraal koppeling: maps a grootboekrekening to its RGS-decentraal D-code, default taakveld, default economische categorie, and Iv3-bucket. The linchpin connecting administrative bookkeeping to CBS Iv3-reporting per REQ-BBV-001. Consumed by the Iv3Export.buckets aggregation.

accountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber. Scoped by administrationId — a tenant maps each account exactly once per REQ-BBV-001.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this mapping. Different tenants may map the same accountNumber to different taakvelden (both valid) per design D2.

rgsCode.description: RGS hoofdcode this account derives from (e.g. 'WLasOlpOlp').

rgsDecentraalCode.description: RGS-decentraal D-code establishing the wettelijke positie. Validated against the active RGS-decentraal seed version per REQ-BBV-001.

omschrijvingKort.description: Short description of the RGS-decentraal post.

referentienummer.description: 5-niveau referentienummer used for confidence-scored auto-mapping of legacy charts per REQ-BBV-001 mass-mapping scenario.

dc.description: Debit/Credit hoofdkenmerk of the RGS-decentraal post.

taakveldDefault.description: FK to Taakveld.code — default taakveld inherited by Account.taakveld and GLLine.taakveld per REQ-BBV-002.

economischeCategorieDefault.description: FK to EconomischeCategorie.code — default cost-type inherited by postings per REQ-BBV-002.

iv3Bucket.description: Iv3-bucket code this account aggregates into. Consumed by the Iv3Export.buckets aggregation (REQ-BBV-006).

omslag.description: Whether rente-omslag applies to this post.

account.description: Each mapping refines exactly one Account within an administration.

Programma.title: Programma
Programma.description: A BBV programma (policy objective) grouping taakvelden, doelstellingen, and beleidsindicatoren. The publish lifecycle enforces meerjarenraming sluitend-checks per REQ-BBV-003.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this programma.

taakvelden.description: Array of Taakveld.code values grouped under this programma.

beleidsindicatoren.description: Array of BeleidsIndicator.code values tracked under this programma.

boekjaar.description: Fiscal year of this programma version.

versie.description: Document version this programma belongs to.

stelselwijziging.description: Marks recomputed comparative figures after a taakveld catalogue change per REQ-BBV-008.

raadsbesluitNummer.description: Raadsbesluit reference motivating a non-sluitende publicatie override per REQ-BBV-003.

published.label: Published
published.description: Vastgesteld; meerjarenraming verified sluitend per REQ-BBV-003.

publish.label: Publiceer begroting
publish.description: Publish the programme budget. Verifies that the meerjarenraming is structureel en reëel sluitend for T..T+3 per REQ-BBV-003. Override requires raadsbesluitNummer + raadsbesluitDatum.

revise.label: Heropen voor wijziging
revise.description: Reopen a published programma for revision (begrotingswijziging).

BeleidsIndicator.title: Beleidsindicator
BeleidsIndicator.description: One of the 39 BBV-verplichte beleidsindicatoren per Regeling Vaststelling Beleidsindicatoren, tracked per programma per administratie (REQ-BBV-007).

programma.description: FK to Programma (composite key reference) this indicator belongs to.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this indicator record.

MeerjarenBudget.title: Meerjarenbudget
MeerjarenBudget.description: A multi-year budget row per (programma, taakveld, economische categorie, boekjaar, horizon). The basis for the sluitend-check at Programma.publish per REQ-BBV-003. Amounts in integer cents to avoid float drift.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this budget row.

programma.description: FK to Programma (nummer) this budget row belongs to.

boekjaar.description: Base fiscal year T of the meerjarenraming.

meerjarenHorizon.description: Horizon offset: 0 = T, 1 = T+1, 2 = T+2, 3 = T+3.

batenCents.description: Budgeted baten in integer eurocents (server-authoritative; never client-trusted floats).

mutatieReservesCents.description: Saldo of reserve-mutaties (may be negative) in integer eurocents, contributing to the sluitend-saldo per REQ-BBV-003.

incidenteelBatenCents.description: Portion of baten that is incidenteel, shown apart per BBV-art. 19 (REQ-BBV-003).

incidenteelLastenCents.description: Portion of lasten that is incidenteel.

begrotingswijziging.description: FK to Begrotingswijziging.nummer when this row results from a wijziging.

stelselwijziging.description: Marks a recomputed comparative figure after a taakveld catalogue change per REQ-BBV-008.

saldoPerJaar.description: Per-horizon sluitend-saldo = sum(batenCents) - sum(lastenCents) + sum(mutatieReservesCents), grouped by (boekjaar, meerjarenHorizon, versie). Consumed by the Programma.publish sluitend-check per REQ-BBV-003.

Reserve.title: Reserve
Reserve.description: A BBV reserve (algemeen of bestemming). Mutaties run uitsluitend via resultaatbestemming op taakveld 0.10 per REQ-BBV-004. Saldi in integer cents.

doel.description: Purpose of the reserve; required for bestemmingsreserves.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this reserve.

programma.description: FK to Programma (nummer) this reserve is linked to.

rentetoerekening.description: Whether rente is toegerekend to this reserve.

saldoBeginJaarCents.description: Saldo at the start of the boekjaar in integer eurocents.

saldoEindJaarCents.description: Saldo at the end of the boekjaar in integer eurocents.

Voorziening.title: Voorziening
Voorziening.description: A BBV voorziening (art. 44 a-d). Mutaties run via exploitatie op het gekoppelde taakveld (dotatie = last, vrijval = negatieve last) per REQ-BBV-004. Saldi in integer cents.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this voorziening.

onderbouwingDocument.description: Docudesk URI of the onderbouwing (e.g. beheerplan).

volgendeActualisatie.description: Date of the next required actualisation.

taakveld.description: FK to Taakveld.code — the gekoppelde exploitatie-taakveld for dotatie/vrijval per REQ-BBV-004.

saldoBeginJaarCents.description: Saldo at the start of the boekjaar in integer eurocents.

dotatiesJaarCents.description: Total dotaties in the boekjaar in integer eurocents.

vrijvallenJaarCents.description: Total vrijvallen in the boekjaar in integer eurocents.

saldoEindJaarCents.description: Saldo at the end of the boekjaar in integer eurocents.

MaterieleVasteActiva.title: Materiële Vaste Activa
MaterieleVasteActiva.description: A BBV MVA record per Notitie MVA (Commissie BBV juli 2023). Activation rules per mva_categorie; afschrijving start month following ingebruikname per REQ-BBV-005. Amounts in integer cents.

mvaCategorie.description: MVA category determining activation vs. P&L treatment per REQ-BBV-005.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this MVA.

aanschafwaardeCents.description: Gross acquisition value in integer eurocents (before subsidie van derden deduction).

subsidieVanDerdenCents.description: Object-earmarked third-party contribution deducted directly from aanschafwaarde (not as bate) per REQ-BBV-005. Te activeren waarde = aanschafwaarde - subsidie.

ingebruiknameDatum.description: In-use date. Depreciation starts the month following this date per REQ-BBV-005.

renteOmslagPercentage.description: Rente-omslag percentage applied to this actief.

taakveld.description: FK to Taakveld.code the afschrijving is booked on.

componentenMethode.description: Whether the componentenmethode applies (samengesteld actief split into components with separate schedules).

boekwaardeBeginJaarCents.description: Boekwaarde at the start of the boekjaar in integer eurocents.

afschrijvingJaarCents.description: Computed depreciation for the boekjaar in integer eurocents.

Subsidie.title: Subsidie
Subsidie.description: A BBV subsidie (verstrekt of ontvangen), optionally linked to a SiSa-indicator for the SiSa-bijlage per REQ-BBV-010. Bedragen in integer cents.

sisaIndicator.description: SiSa-bijlage indicator code (e.g. 'H8'). If empty for a SiSa-plichtige regeling, a warning fires per REQ-BBV-010.

verstrekkerOfOntvanger.description: Counterparty (verstrekker for ontvangen, ontvanger for verstrekt).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this subsidie.

bedragVastgesteldCents.description: Final established amount in integer eurocents.

taakveld.description: FK to Taakveld.code placing the subsidie in the BBV hierarchy.

Begrotingswijziging.title: Begrotingswijziging
Begrotingswijziging.description: A BBV begrotingswijziging amending a budget line, tied to a raadsbesluit. Bedragen in integer cents.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this wijziging.

bedragWijzigingCents.description: Change amount (may be negative) in integer eurocents.

Paragraaf.title: Paragraaf
Paragraaf.description: One of the 7 verplichte BBV-paragrafen (art. 9). All 7 must be present and non-empty before a jaarrekening can be vastgesteld per REQ-BBV-007.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this paragraaf.

inhoud.description: Free-text content of the paragraaf (template-driven editor output).

weerstandsratio.description: Auto-computed weerstandsratio (beschikbaar / benodigd) for the Weerstandsvermogen paragraaf per REQ-BBV-007.

compleet.description: Whether the paragraaf is filled and signed-off.

iv3-xml-transformation.name: IV3 XML Transformation
iv3-xml-transformation.description: Maps an Iv3Export record (with aggregated buckets) to the CBS IV3-bestand XML structure. ADR-031 declarative path — preferred over a PHP renderer. If OR's mapping engine cannot express CBS mixed-content XML nodes, the Iv3XmlRenderer::render() exception path (documented in openspec/changes/add-shillinq-iv3-reporting/design.md §D3) applies.
